definitions.explanation: A soft, rectangular loaf of white bread sold in thick slices, typically 4-, 5-, 6-, or 8-slice cuts. A staple breakfast food in Japan.

examples.japanese: {食|しょく}パン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一斤|いっきん}⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought one loaf of bread.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{食|しょく}パン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦バター→バター：04671_bataa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}って→塗る：01174_nuru⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: In the morning I eat toast with butter.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食|しょく}パン⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧やわらかくて⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This shop's bread is popular because it's soft all the way to the crust.

notes:
Short for ⟦{主食|しゅしょく}→主食：11408_shushoku⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧ (staple bread). Refers specifically to the rectangular white loaf sold at bakeries and supermarkets, as distinct from other bread types like ⟦フランス→フランス：19418_furansu⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧ (baguette) or ⟦{菓子|かし}→菓子：00191_kashi⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧ (sweet bread).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食|しょく}パン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ (toast bread)
- {食|しょく}パン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧ (bread crust — literally "ears")
- {六枚切|ろくまいぎ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食|しょく}パン (bread sliced into six)

In Japan, {食|しょく}パン is typically sold in thicker slices than Western bread. The most popular thickness is {六枚切|ろくまいぎ}り (6 slices per loaf), though {四枚切|よんまいぎ}り (4 slices, thick) is common in the Kansai region.
